description: AI-powered meeting assistant that records audio, writes notes, generates summaries, and extracts action items.
auth_notes: No public API or developer auth method is documented for Otter.ai.
credential_notes: No self-serve developer API or developer credentials portal is publicly available.
api_notes: No public developer API is available; integrations are limited to native platform connectors like Zapier, Slack, and CRM tools.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provided by Otter.ai.
rationale: Otter.ai does not offer a public developer API or self-serve API credentials, making direct agent integration impossible today.

evidence.note: Help center shows integrations are restricted to predefined app connectors (Zapier, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot) with no public API documentation.

open_questions: Does Otter.ai offer a private or enterprise-gated API for partner integrations?
